verdict.rationale: Extend confirms a Python package (`pip install extend-ai`) and a dedicated SDKs page in docs, plus API/agent quickstarts and a CLI, suggesting official SDK support exists, but the evidence never confirms a TypeScript SDK, typed interfaces, or explicit coverage of parse/extract/jobs endpoints with default configs. missing for 10: explicit TypeScript SDK evidence, confirmation of type definitions, and documented default parameters/examples across parse/extract/jobs.
